title: 3dLocalUnifize
description: This program generates a 'unifized' output volume by estimating the median in the local neighborhood of each voxel and using that to scale each voxel's brightness.

working_dir.description: Name of temporary working directory (def: __wdir_LocalUni_, plus a random alphanumeric str)
working_dir.title: Working directory name

echo.description: Run this program very verbosely (default: false)
echo.title: Verbose mode

no_clean.description: Do not remove the working directory (default: remove it)
no_clean.title: Do not remove working directory

local_rad.description: The spherical neighborhood's radius for the 3dLocalStat step (default: -3)
local_rad.title: Local radius

local_perc.description: The percentile used in the 3dLocalStat step, generating the scaling volume (default: 50)
local_perc.title: Local percentile

local_mask.description: Provide the masking option for the 3dLocalStat step; to remove any masking, put 'None' as the option value (default: "-automask")
local_mask.title: Local mask

filter_thr.description: Ceiling on values in the final, scaled dataset; values <=0 turn off this final filtering (default: 1.5)
filter_thr.title: Filter threshold
